say:1:1422913001:0.text: Ugh, I need a break. Time to walk around and stretch my legs...
say:1:1422913001:0.source_cn: 呼……钓累了，走一走，活动活动腿脚……

say:2:1422913002:0.text: Hey, your fish bag's empty too! Guess we're both in the same boat here!
say:2:1422913002:0.source_cn: 咦，你这鱼护里不也空空如也，什么都没钓上来嘛！

say:3:1422913003:1.text: You have no idea how to fish for the rockguana, do you? Don't you understand the basics of baiting?
say:3:1422913003:1.source_cn: 你对古岩鬣蜥是一点都不了解啊。打窝诱鱼的道理你不懂吗？

say:4:1422913004:1.text: I know what I'm doing! I've been using shrimp, just like Duram said... Should I be using more?
say:4:1422913004:1.source_cn: 我当然懂！我刚刚已经用鱼王喜欢的赤虾饵打了很久的窝……...

say:5:1422913005:1.text: Ha, you're new to this, huh? Hate to break it to you, but you got played.
say:5:1422913005:1.source_cn: 哈哈，这些话只能骗骗你这种新手了。

say:6:1422913006:1.text: You're all excited about the Fish King, but you don't even know what attracts it or what it loves to eat!
say:6:1422913006:1.source_cn: 你只嚷嚷着要钓鱼王，却不知道是什么把鱼王吸引来这里，鱼...

say:7:1422913007:1.text: Oh? What do YOU know about the Fish King?!

say:8:1422913008:1.text: I've been tracking the rockguana for ages. Tried every bait, every spot. Finally cracked it. The Fish King loves places where dwarves dump their old mechanical junk.
say:8:1422913008:1.source_cn: 我追踪了古岩鬣蜥很久，试过无数钓饵和钓点，最后发现 ，...

say:9:1422913009:1.text: In other words, the rockguana's favorite food is... metal scraps.
say:9:1422913009:1.source_cn: 古岩鬣蜥爱吃的，正是那些铁疙瘩。

say:12:1422913011:1.text: You've got a point. And that's how I'll be able to land the Fish King.
say:12:1422913011:1.source_cn: 你说的没错，但正因为这样的原因，我才能钓上鱼王。
say:12:1422913011:1.male: You've got a point. And that's how I'll be able to land the Fish King.
say:12:1422913011:1.female: You've got a point. And that's how I'll be able to land the Fish King.

say:13:1422913012:1.text: So, what are you two standing around for? I've gotta keep baiting!
say:13:1422913012:1.source_cn: 你们在这站着干嘛？我可要继续打窝了。
say:13:1422913012:1.male: So, what are you two standing around for? I've gotta keep baiting!
say:13:1422913012:1.female: So, what are you two standing around for? I've gotta keep baiting!

say:14:1422913013:1.text: How are you gonna do that?

say:16:1422913014:0.text: Simple. I'm tossing all these metal scraps I've gathered into the lake.
say:16:1422913014:0.source_cn: 当然是把这些我准备好的铁疙瘩扔进湖里去。

say:17:1422913015:1.text: Will that really work? Should we... try that too?
say:17:1422913015:1.source_cn: 这样真的管用吗？要不我们也……试试……
say:17:1422913015:1.male: Will that really work? Should we... try that too?
say:17:1422913015:1.female: Will that really work? Should we... try that too?

say:18:1422913016:1.text: By all means, go ahead. I don't mind a little competition.
say:18:1422913016:1.source_cn: 我既然告诉了你们，就不怕你们用同样的法子。

say:19:1422913017:1.text: But ditch the shrimp bait if you're near me—it'll scare the real catches off.
say:19:1422913017:1.source_cn: 别用那骗人的什么虾饵在我面前晃悠了，去找点铁疙瘩来，我...
